description: This file defines the interface IGraph within the Graphing namespace, specifying virtual methods for graph initialization, options, variables, rendering, analysis, and selection reset, serving as a contract for graph-related classes.

classes.name: IGraph
classes.description: An interface for graph objects providing methods for initialization, configuration, rendering, analysis, and interaction.

methods.name: TryInitialize
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the graph with an optional expression, returning an optional list of equations.

methods.name: GetInitializationError
methods.description: Retrieves the error code if initialization failed.

methods.name: GetOptions
methods.description: Returns the graphing options associated with the graph.

methods.name: GetVariables
methods.description: Returns the list of variables used in the graph.

methods.name: SetArgValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified variable by name.

methods.name: GetRenderer
methods.description: Provides access to the graph renderer.

methods.name: TryResetSelection
methods.description: Attempts to reset any selection on the graph.

methods.name: GetAnalyzer
methods.description: Returns the graph analyzer associated with the graph.
